HCL Technologies, India Delivery Manager-Senior Project Manager

(Leading IT Services & Fortune Company)

Dec 18-July 24

➢ Responsible for Customer Engagement, Delivery, Program, Product, Project Management, for USA based Global Fortune companies, in Healthcare, MedTech, Orthodontic, Automotive etc. ➢ Utilized Agile, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe etc using Jira, Confluence and Project Management software applications. Coordinated Requirements gathering sessions, User story analysis, Grooming, Product Backlog and ensured effective Sprint ceremonies and action. Implemented Dashboards, Kanban boards, Charts, Reports, ensuring on Time Delivery and Execution.

➢ Managed 60+ Team members across Geography for Agile projects- Time and Material, Fixed Price, Waterfall for Application Life Cycle (ALM-Polarion), Product Lifecycle (PLM-Teamcenter, Windchill etc) CAD (CATIA, AutoCAD etc) Desktop (C++, Python, .NET) Web (Java, React), Cloud (AWS, Azure etc) & Internet of Things (IOT) ThingWorx etc.

➢ Utilized tools such as Value stream mapping, Requirements traceability matrix, ensured Software Testing, Verification and Validation etc per FDA and Regulatory requirements, ISO 13485 etc. ➢ Utilized Industry standards, framework, CI/CD Tools etc to develop and implement software

solutions. Accomplished >50% Margin across Projects, ensured Customer Delight in CSAT.

➢ Facilitated workshops for value creation, Lean, Six sigma projects identification and execution.

Conducted COVID Risk assessment, ensuring Project delivery, revenue and margin growth.

Idea Cellular, Pune, India MBB/L6S/TQM Functional Head (Reporting to COO)

(Aditya Birla Group Global Fortune Company)

Dec 09-Jan-13

➢ Responsible for wing-to-wing Business Transformation in ~700 Mn USD company (Part of ~40Bn USD ABG Group). Analyzed key organizational business goals, key metrics, & developed Business Strategy, road map, implemented/mentored 20 Big Y, business critical projects in IT, Quality, Cost, Revenue, Market share, Delivery etc.

➢ Contributed ~$14 Mn USD/750 Mn rupees net benefit to Business (EBIT) & significantly improved key business parameters (CTQ) across functions such as Operations, Supply Chain, Service Delivery, Sales, & Marketing etc through BB/GB/IT, Big Data, Analytics projects etc. ➢ Developed process simplification, standardization, automation (Poka Yoke) through Agile, Scrum framework, application development, alarm management, work flow tool development etc. ➢ Reduced CAP-EX cost through supply chain process streamlining, optimization, vendor process simplification, reverse logistics process & developing a in house refurbishing process saving organization ~75 Mn rupees/annum (~$1.7 Mn USD)

➢ Optimized OP-EX cost in terms of cell site running cost by eliminating waste, operational inefficiencies, reducing Diesel consumption by 12% saving ~25 Mn rupees/annum ($0.6Mn USD) Improved customer experience/ NWS Quality/CSAT by 8% by reducing service outages due to NWS optical fiber cut, improving annualized realized revenue by ~500 Mn (~$11 Mn USD)

➢

➢ Assessed organizations Idea, Ultratech, Hindalco on World Class Excellence Capability maturity Model/ EFQM, Developed action plan for Maturity level, Unique Customer Value Proposition etc

GE Healthcare (Medical Systems), USA Lean Leader

(Global Fortune 10 Company) Feb 07- July 09

➢ Responsible for wing-to-wing process improvements in a 700 Million USD Supply chain, Developed Business Strategy- road map, implemented Lean, ISO 13485 & FDA regulatory requirements etc. Facilitated cross-functional Kaizens, Lean Work Outs & Value Steam Mapping sessions. Led Big Y Business Critical Projects for Productivity, Quality, & Customer metrics.

➢ Led Product enhancement for Field Service Engineer mobile application. Led Project on Quality Parts delivery in Field. Financially owned 2008 P&L, develop OP, Implemented Poka Yoke in Oracle/FEMC/Analytics/Tableau Analytics tool and reduced defects by 35% and net loss from $4.4 Mn in 2007 to $2.1 Mn in 2008 & less than $1 Mn in 2009.

➢ Led Global cross-functional, cross org, Kaizen for Parts Quality Failure using (CAD, PLM). Reduced FOA in field by 10% & improved Services Customer Net Promoter Score (NPS) by 15%.

➢ Led Gold Seal Product business strategy workout for MR LCAT line, Develop annual Kaizen road

map, improve productivity by 10%. Received appreciation-VP Supply chain.

➢ Trained & Mentored the Functional Leaders & Global GE Healthcare team in Agile, SAFe, Lean

Six Sigma, Change Acceleration Process & Kaizen execution.

ThyssenKrupp Automotive, USA Quality Engineer-Black Belt

(Global Fortune 100 company) May 2003-Jan 2007

➢ Analyzed key organizational business goals, key metrics, performed gap analysis & identified improvement opportunities. Developed action plan to meet business goals & implemented Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, Kanban, Productivity/Process improvement, ISO implementation etc.

➢ Planned, coordinated Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production part approval Process (PPAP) for product launch for Heavy Duty, Diesel Engine OEMs-CAT, Cummins, Deere ➢ Participated in Requirements gathering, Testing, and Functional UAT for SAP Manufacturing,

Production Planning, Quality modules and Visual SPC Applications, Tableau etc.

➢ Jointly led cross functional team between CAT and supplier for quality/process improvement/ for a new product line (SIPOC), resulted in robust process and savings of over $ 500,000 USD.

➢ Led cross-functional NCM/Defect/COPQ reduction for all product lines~ 40% reductions.

Additional Professional skills: Game Changer, Customer Champion, Result oriented.
